definitions.name: meterOrdinaryProper
context: open RMAF Universal233 WholeSourceWork CoreWork GenericForest.CheckCorrespondence
definitions.code:
def meterOrdinaryProper (T S : Tree) : Charged Bool :=
 let a:=meterLeaves T;let b:=meterNodup a.value
 let c:=meterLeaves S;let d:=meterNodup c.value
 let e:=meterLeaves T;let f:=meterLeaves S;let p:=meterPerm e.value f.value
 ⟨b.value&&d.value&&p.value,a.work+b.work+c.work+d.work+e.work+f.work+p.work+4⟩

definitions.name: meterContains
context: open RMAF VertexGeometry CoreProgram CoreWork WholeSourceMass
definitions.code:
def meterContains (x : Nat) : List Nat → Charged Bool
  | [] => ⟨false,1⟩
  | y::ys => if x == y then ⟨true,4⟩ else
      let r := meterContains x ys
      ⟨r.value,4+r.work⟩

definitions.name: meterErase
context: open RMAF Universal233 WholeSourceWork CoreWork GenericForest.CheckCorrespondence

definitions.name: meterPerm
context: open RMAF Universal233 WholeSourceWork CoreWork GenericForest.CheckCorrespondence
definitions.code:
def meterPerm : List Nat→List Nat→Charged Bool
 | [],ys=>⟨ys.isEmpty,1⟩
 | x::xs,ys=>let c:=meterContains x ys;let e:=meterErase x ys;let r:=meterPerm xs e.value
   ⟨c.value&&r.value,c.work+e.work+r.work+4⟩

definitions.name: meterLeaves
context: open RMAF ForestState RestrictionBridge Universal233 WholeSourceWork CoreWork
definitions.code:
def meterLeaves : Tree → Charged (List Nat)
 | .leaf x=>⟨[x],4⟩
 | .node l r=>let a:=meterLeaves l;let b:=meterLeaves r
              ⟨a.value++b.value,a.work+b.work+6*(a.value.length+1)⟩

definitions.name: meterNodup
context: open RMAF ForestState RestrictionBridge Universal233 WholeSourceWork CoreWork
definitions.code:
def meterNodup : List Nat → Charged Bool
 | []=>⟨true,1⟩
 | x::xs=>let c:=meterContains x xs;let r:=meterNodup xs;⟨!c.value&&r.value,c.work+r.work+4⟩
